summary: Self-contained 420-line Coq module encoding Chatzikyriakidis & Luo's four-way MTT classification of adjectives: intersective via Sigma-types, subsective via Pi-polymorphism over a CN universe, privative via a disjoint-union type, non-committal via (nominally) Ranta belief contexts. The privative section is faithful and proves 2013 (28)/(30) = book (3.121). The subsective typing matches 2013 (22)/(23) and book (3.102) in shape. Two defects break faithfulness: intersective modification routes through an added universal map `cn_to_object : forall N:Set, N -> Object` instead of coercive subtyping, so the source's defining Sigma-propagation inference (black man => black human; 2013 (20), book (3.91)) is neither stated nor derivable and `black @I nat` is a well-formed CN; and non-committal modification is `N * nat`, whose `fst` yields Adj[N] => N, the very entailment the class must not license, while the BeliefContext/Believes apparatus is dead code. A bolted-on Tarski-style universe `cn` with seven propositional decoding axioms makes the subsective pi1 coercions non-reducing transports. 12/12 theorems Qed, but four are vacuous or verbatim duplicates. Load-bearing infrastructure for extras/Quantifiers.v and extras/quanrifiers2.v.

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2013). Adjectives in a Modern Type-Theoretical Setting. In Morrill & Nederhof (eds.), FG 2012/2013, LNCS 8036, pp. 159-174. Springer.

Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. ISTE/Wiley. Section 3.3 'Adjectival modification: a case study' (pp. 65-74, Table 3.2, (3.88)-(3.127)) and Appendix A7.3-A7.4 (pp. 194-196, Coq code for intersective/subsective and privative adjectives).

definitions_mapped.note: Function-typed axioms declared as Coq coercions. The chain Man->Human->Animal->Object is exercised only by `Check tall john` (L391) and by `tall x` for x : BlackMan (verified: unfolds to tall (ao (ha (mh (blackman_to_man x))))); no adjective *definition* uses it, because intersective_mod goes through cn_to_object instead.

definitions_mapped.note: Coq `sig` with Prop-valued second component, matching UTT's Prop. The book's proof-irrelevance adequacy condition (§3.3.1, pp. 68-69, fn. 22) is not addressed.

definitions_mapped.coq: cn : Type; Tcn : cn -> CN (Coercion); human_cn..doctor_cn : cn; seven Axioms `Tcn X_cn = X` (L50-65)

definitions_mapped.note: The source's decoding is definitional; here it is seven propositional equality axioms on Set. Redundant with CN := Set (the book simply uses CN as the universe). Consequence: coercions built by `rewrite <- surgeon_interp` (L162-181) are eq_rect transports along an axiom and do not reduce (Eval cbv shows `match surgeon_interp in (_ = a) return a with eq_refl => let (a,_) := x in a end`).

definitions_mapped.coq: cn_to_object : forall N:CN, N -> Object (L75)
definitions_mapped.source: none — the source obtains black(m) for m:[[man]] from [[man]] < [[object]] plus contravariance/propagation (2013 §3 p.166-167; book (3.88)-(3.90))
definitions_mapped.note: A single universal map from every Set into Object with no coherence axioms. Overgenerates: `Definition BlackNat : CN := black @I nat` typechecks (verified). And `black (cn_to_object Man m)` is a different, unrelated proposition from `black (ao (ha (mh m)))`; Print Assumptions on intersective_inheritance lists cn_to_object and none of mh/ha/ao.

definitions_mapped.note: white, red, light, round are declared and never used.

definitions_mapped.coq: intersective_mod adj N := Sigma N (fun x => adj (cn_to_object N x)); notation @I; BlackMan, HeavyObject, TallHuman (L84-93)

theorems.name: intersective_inheritance (L116)
theorems.source_claim: Adj[N] => Adj: if p : Sigma x:[[N]].[[Adj]](x) then [[Adj]](pi1 p) is true (2013 p.167 'a black man is something black'; book (3.95)-(3.97))
theorems.note: Second projection of sig. Establishes blackness only at the cn_to_object-image, not as a black Object/Human reachable by the coercion chain.

theorems.name: intersective_cross_type (L126)

theorems.note: Restatement of privative_inferences under the file's `all` quantifier.

evidence: Compiles under Coq 8.20.1 (exit 0); all 12 Theorem statements close with Qed; no Admitted. Print Assumptions on every theorem shows only Parameters/type constants except subsective_inferences, which depends on the axiom surgeon_interp; `Require Import Classical` (L7) is never used.

Privative class is faithful: Gun as two-constructor inductive with injection coercions (L218-234) = G = GR + GF with GR <_inl G, GF <_inr G (2013 §4 p.169; book (3.110)); is_real_gun/is_fake_gun (L237-247) = 2013 p.170 / book (3.111)-(3.112); privative_property (L250) = 2013 (28); fake_not_real (L264) = book (3.121). Omitted: polymorphic fake/real (book (3.113)-(3.115), A7.4) and 'either real or fake' (book (3.120)).

Subsective typing is faithful in shape: Subsective_Adj (L141) is exactly 2013 (22)/book (3.102); subsective_mod (L147) is book (3.103); cnH and Restricted_Subsective_Adj (L197-203) are 2013 (23). Deviation: skillful is typed over full cn (L144) although 2013 p.168 argues it must be over cnH; cnH names are unlinked to cn names.

Intersective class deviates at the mechanism the source calls essential: intersective_mod (L84) routes through the added universal cn_to_object (L75) rather than coercive subtyping. Consequences verified in scratch: (a) `black @I nat : CN` typechecks, contradicting the many-sortedness argument (2013 §2.2, §3 'no interpretation of beautiful man'); (b) the goal `black (cn_to_object Human (mh m))` is not closed by the hypothesis `black (cn_to_object Man m)`, so 2013 (20)/book (3.91) 'a black man is a black human' is underivable; (c) Print Assumptions of intersective_inheritance lists cn_to_object and no coercion axiom.

Non-committal class is encoded contrary to the source: noncommittal_mod N := prod (Tcn N) nat (L293). `fst : AllegedCriminal -> Tcn criminal_cn` typechecks (verified), i.e. Adj[N] => N, which is the inference that defines the class by its absence (2013 (34); book (3.122), Table 3.2). BeliefContext/Believes (L280-288) are dead code and Believes is list membership rather than Ranta's Pi Gamma_p. A (2013 (35)). The book's own correction (H_{h,Adj} : Prop -> Prop, (3.127), fn. 23) is not followed either. The associated theorem (L300) concludes True.

The universe cn is rendered with seven propositional decoding axioms (L59-65) in place of definitional Tcn (2013 §2.4); the subsective coercions (L162-181) are eq_rect transports along them and do not reduce (Eval cbv verified).

Four of twelve theorems carry no content: noncommittal_no_direct_entailment (L300, `True`), subsective_inferences (L347, `exists y, y = f x`), skillful_surgeons_are_human (L375, `fun _ => True`), intersective_inferences (L338, verbatim copy of L126). The file's summary block (L399-419, 'complete, compositional, type-safe treatment') overstates what is proved.

Unused declarations: Diamond/RealDiamond/FakeDiamond (L219-228), Pred1 (L43), RealGunType (L260), AllegedPresident (L297), BeliefContext/Believes, and the parameters white red light round small fast beautiful wise brave. Duplicated comment lines at L262-263, L290-292, L381-382.
omissions: Coercion propagation through Sigma: 'a black man => a black human' (2013 (20); book (3.91), fn. 20).
Pi-polymorphic fake/real over CN with fake(G) = fake_g (book (3.113)-(3.115); A7.4) and the 2013 alternative real, fake : Object -> Prop with G < Object (2013 (33)).
'That gun is either real or fake' (book (3.118)/(3.120); A7.4 Theorem either) — provable in one line from the file's definitions.
Proof-irrelevance adequacy condition for Sigma-type modification (book §3.3.1 pp. 68-69).
Any genuine non-entailment result for non-committal adjectives; the book's modal-collection account (3.125)-(3.127).
additions: cn_to_object : forall N:Set, N -> Object (L75) — universal coercion absent from the source; overgenerates and is incoherent with the declared coercion chain.
Separate opaque universe cn : Type with seven propositional decoding axioms (L50-65), redundant with CN := Set.
noncommittal_mod as N * nat (L293) — no counterpart in either source.
Adjective stacking TallSkillfulSurgeon / SkillfulTallSurgeon and complex_composition (L314-331).
Unused Diamond type, Pred1, BeliefContext/Believes, RealGunType, AllegedPresident.
simplifications: Per-instance pi1 coercions (L103-113, L184-186) instead of the general Sigma(N,Adj) <_pi1 N rule.
skillful typed over full cn rather than cnH (L144 vs 2013 (23)).
Gun-specific is_real_gun/is_fake_gun instead of polymorphic fake/real (book (3.113)).
Believes as list membership rather than Pi over a context (L286-288).

determination_rationale: The source theory's core — CNs as types, Sigma-type modification, Pi-polymorphic subsective adjectives over a CN universe, disjoint-union privatives — encodes directly in Coq, as the book's own Appendix A7.3/A7.4 demonstrates with Records, `:>` coercions and `sum`, and this file reproduces those three classes with their inferences ((28), (30)/(3.121), second-projection facts) proved. What Coq does not supply natively, and a faithful encoding must add by hand, is small and well-understood: (a) coercive subtyping does not propagate through Sigma and Coq will not accept a generic Coercion on a Sigma-forming function, so Sigma(N,Adj) <_pi1 N and Sigma(N,Adj) <= Sigma(N',Adj) must be declared per instance or proved as lemmas (the file's L99-100 comment recognises this; its failure to state (3.91) is an omission, not an obstacle); (b) the CN universe must be Russell-style (Set) rather than a Tarski universe with definitional Tcn — using Set directly is what the book does, and the file's bolted-on axiomatic `cn` is the cause of its transport opacity, not a necessity; (c) the proof-irrelevance condition of book §3.3.1 is not definitional in Prop and would need SProp or an axiom. The non-committal class is the only part needing more: the 2013 account reifies Ranta's meta-level contexts (Pi Gamma_p. A), which have no first-class Coq object, but the source itself retracts that account and its replacement H_{h,Adj} : Prop -> Prop is a one-line Parameter; this file attempted neither, and its N * nat encoding is an error in the file, not evidence about the theory. Net: formalizable with slight, local modifications; the file's defects trace to encoding choices rather than to the framework.

artifact_classes.description: Universe-level / type-value collapse: the source's Tarski-style universe cn of CN names with definitional decoding Tcn has no Coq counterpart. The file uses Set as CN (Russell-style, as the book does) and then adds a second opaque `cn : Type` whose decoding is seven propositional axioms `Tcn X_cn = X` (L59-65) — equalities between types in Set that must be transported along. The universal `cn_to_object : forall N:Set, N -> Object` (L75) likewise quantifies over all of Set, collapsing the intended universe of CNs into all small types (`black @I nat : CN` verified).

Computational opacity: the subsective pi1 coercions (L162-181) are defined by `rewrite <- X_interp` and unfold to `match surgeon_interp in (_ = a) return a with eq_refl => let (a,_) := x in a end`; they are stuck on an axiom and do not reduce to proj1_sig, so no theorem can compute through them and subsective_inferences (L347) degenerates to a trivial existential depending on the axiom. cn_to_object is an opaque Parameter with no coherence axioms, so the two routes from Man to Object (cn_to_object Man vs ao o ha o mh) yield unrelated propositions.

Missing native structure: Coq's Coercion mechanism has neither propagation through Sigma/Pi (2013 p.167; book (3.91), fn. 20) nor a generic sig-to-carrier coercion, so the source's Sigma(N,Adj) <_pi1 N must be declared per adjective-noun pair (L103-113, L184-186) and Sigma-propagation must be proved by hand (here it is not). Ranta's belief contexts Gamma_p are meta-level telescopes with no first-class Coq object; the file substitutes `list Prop` membership (L280-288) and then abandons it.

duplicate_note: No substantive duplicate. /Users/graogro/Dropbox/revisiting-formal-semantics/ttr_mtt/Book_Inter_Sub.v (29 lines, loads Coq_book_ontology) transcribes book Appendix A7.3 verbatim (Irish delegate, polymorphic Skillful via Records with `:>`, theorems delegate1/delegate2/skill1 and the aborted skill2); it covers only intersective/subsective inference examples, nothing privative or non-committal, from a different source passage — a companion, not a duplicate. Of the two, Book_Inter_Sub.v is the more faithful rendering of the subsective mechanism (CN=Set directly, Record coercions, no transport axioms), while AdjectivesExtension.v is the only repo file covering the privative disjoint-union account (no ttr_mtt file transcribes A7.4). extras/PolydefiniteSemantics.v mentions 'alleged'/'intersective'/'privative' but formalises a different source (Greek polydefinites over MontagueFragment). Dependents: extras/Quantifiers.v and extras/quanrifiers2.v `Require Import AdjectivesExtension` and reuse SkillfulSurgeon, is_fake_gun, is_real_gun, Intersective_Adj, skillful_surgeon_to_surgeon — so this file is load-bearing infrastructure for that pair. None of the task's candidate duplicate groups include this file.
source_gap: None. Both primary sources are on disk in full: the 2013 FG/LNCS paper (16 pp., 159-174) and the 2020 book (240 pp.); the relevant book passages (§3.3 pp. 65-74 incl. Table 3.2 and (3.88)-(3.127); Appendix A7.3-A7.4 pp. 194-196) were extracted and read.
notes: Compiled from the repo root with `coqc -R shallow "" -R deep "" -R extras "" -R ttr_mtt "" -R atlas "" extras/AdjectivesExtension.v`; exit 0; only the three `Check` outputs (L391-393) printed. Claims about underivability of (3.91), the AllegedCriminal `fst` leak, the non-reducing coercion, `black @I nat`, the omitted `either` theorem, and per-theorem assumption sets were verified by two scratch modules importing the compiled AdjectivesExtension.vo (scratchpad check_adj.v and check_adj2.v, both exit 0). Axiom inventory: 6 function-typed coercion Axioms (L25-30; declarations, not propositions) and 7 propositional type-equality axioms (L59-65); everything else is a Parameter (types, individuals, predicates, universe names). The Coq file was not modified. A prior record at this path existed and was consistent with these findings; it has been rewritten from this independent verification.
